question: Should maintainers sponsor this combined publisher feed, follow graph, and notification stack as one PR, or require it to be split/restacked before review?
rationale: The branch adds durable schema, a public authenticated API, notification behavior, and visible UI on top of open draft siblings, so source review alone cannot choose the intended product/API landing order.

options.title: Restack and prove the combined stack
options.body: Keep the combined direction, but require conflict resolution, clear dependency order, real Convex runtime validation, and redacted browser/HTTP proof before merge.

options.title: Split to feed routes only
options.body: Limit this PR to canonical public feed routes and move follow graph, controls, and notifications back to their narrower draft PRs.

options.title: Pause until follow/feed direction is owned
options.body: Leave the draft parked until maintainers decide the permanent follow/feed product and API contract.

recommendation.title: Restack and prove the combined stack
recommendation.body: Keep the combined direction, but require conflict resolution, clear dependency order, real Convex runtime validation, and redacted browser/HTTP proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The current publisher route/profile/schema baseline being extended traces most directly to Patrick-Erichsen's a230d962 work.
